messages:
noah: Heads up - Prospect (regulated FINTECH) insists on VPC peering for the POC. Need a compact runbook for their infra team: routing, SGs, and how we deliver a scoped API key securely. POC target in 8 days.

zoe: Summary runbook to give them: 1) Confirm VPC CIDRs do not overlap. 2) Customer creates VPC peering request -> give us the request ID. 3) We accept the peering (we'll keep manual accept for now). 4) Add explicit route table entries for the app subnets -> peering ID. 5) Update security groups on our side to allow inbound 443 from their app subnet CIDRs only. 6) If they use NACLs, allow ephemeral ports 1024-65535. 7) Test from a bastion: curl to our control-plane IP/DNS.

devon: Notes / gotchas: - Peering doesn't provide private DNS; if they want friendly hostnames we can provide an internal IP or they must use our public DNS (NAT). - Transit GW case: if they route via TGW, verify TGW route propagation allows peering. - Overlap is a hard stop. - Recommend they create peering in 2 AZs for HA on their side (routes still per-subnet).

security-bot: Audit + key delivery: we can issue a scoped POC API key (24-48h TTL). Preferred delivery: push to their vault via a presigned, single-use S3 upload link OR add to their vault integration (if available). All issuance events will be recorded with an audit-id and surfaced in the ticket. CloudTrail captures Peering Accept events.

infra-bot: Minimal customer TF snippet: `resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" { vpc_id = var.vpc_id peer_owner_id = var.redwood_account_id peer_vpc_id = var.redwood_vpc_id } resource "aws_route" "to_redwood" { route_table_id = var.route_table_id destination_cidr_block = var.redwood_cidr vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer.id }`

noah: Great, please drop this as a one-pager to the prospect. I'll request their CIDRs and peering ID. If they push back on NAT/egress allowlist, escalate Dedicated/Private as an option in the SOW.

zoe: Sending now. Setting expectation: we'll manually accept peering within 48 hours of receiving the request and CIDRs.

devon: If they want to migrate to PrivateLink later, note we need to remove peering routes and coordinate a short cutover window to avoid dropped traffic.

noah: Thanks team. I'll post the peering request ID when it arrives.
